track.title: After the Release
track.purpose: Keep the mechanical pulse while open harmony follows a pressure interval.
track.hypothesis: Sparse harmony can create recovery without losing the rhythmic anchor.
track.invariant: Root and fifth bass attacks retain the same rhythm across harmony changes.
